description: This file declares callback functions related to the LIN State Manager (LinSM) in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform. It provides function prototypes for handling schedule requests, wake-up confirmations, sleep transitions, and internal timer tick events.

methods.name: LinSM_ScheduleRequest_Confirmation
methods.description: Handles confirmation of schedule requests for a specified network channel.

methods.name: LinSM_WakeUp_Confirmation
methods.description: Handles confirmation of wake-up events for a specified network channel, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: LinSM_GotoSleep_Confirmation
methods.description: Handles confirmation of transition to sleep mode for a specified network channel, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: LinSM_TimerTick
methods.description: Own timer tick function for internal timers within LinSM.
